Single Sample
Linear Classification (single sample)
• For x ∈RD, the linear classifier computes logits:
z = W Tx + b
where W ∈RD×K and b ∈RK.
• Prediction (activation):
ˆy = Activation(z)
Logistic regression (and softmax / multi-label logistic) are linear models
followed by a non-linear activation.

PyTorch: Loss Function Notes
Important Note (PyTorch)
• Do NOT add activation at the model output
• Loss functions in PyTorch already include the required activation
internally
• Adding activation twice leads to:
• Wrong gradients
• Slower or unstable training

title: Programming View
text:
Programming View
Keras: Loss Function Notes
Keras Design Philosophy
• In Keras, the activation function is usually part of the model
• By default, loss functions expect probabilities as input
• Therefore, model outputs are typically already normalized
Important Notes
• Forgetting the activation leads to invalid probability outputs
• Wrong activation ⇒wrong learning objective
• Some Keras losses support logits via from logits=True

title: Training Methods
text:
Training Methods
Overview
Training Classification Models
• Closed-form Solution
• Not available for classification
• Due to non-linear activation (Sigmoid / Softmax)
• Gradient Descent (Iterative Optimization)
• Treat training as an optimization problem
• Update parameters iteratively
• Standard approach for all classification models
Classification models must be trained using iterative optimization.
